settings.connection.enableDeveloper.desc: On the phone, open “Settings → About phone” and tap the build number about seven times. Then enable USB debugging in Developer options. Menu names vary slightly by manufacturer.
settings.connection.usb.title: USB connection
settings.connection.usb.description: The most reliable option and recommended for first use
settings.connection.usb.step1: Connect the computer and phone with a USB cable that supports data transfer.
settings.connection.usb.step2: Unlock the phone and confirm this computer's RSA fingerprint in the “Allow USB debugging” dialog.
settings.connection.usb.step3: MirroDeck discovers the device automatically. Once “Available · USB” appears in the sidebar, select it and choose “Start mirroring”.
settings.connection.wifi.title: Wi-Fi connection
settings.connection.wifi.description: For Android 11 or later; the computer and phone must be on the same local network
settings.connection.wifi.step1: Enable Wireless debugging under Developer options on the phone.
settings.connection.wifi.step2: Tap “Pair device with pairing code” on the phone, then choose “Add device → Wi-Fi connection” in MirroDeck.
settings.connection.wifi.step3: Enter the IP address, port, and six-digit code from the pairing dialog to authorize the device.
settings.connection.wifi.step4: After pairing succeeds, MirroDeck opens the connection step automatically. Return to the main Wireless debugging screen and enter the address shown there.
settings.connection.wifi.step5: Once “Available · Wi-Fi” appears in the sidebar, select the device and choose “Start mirroring”.
settings.connection.wifi.note: The pairing and connection ports usually differ: pair with the address in the pairing dialog, then connect with the address on the main Wireless debugging screen.
settings.connection.emulator.title: Android emulator
settings.connection.emulator.description: Connect to a running local emulator that is accessible through adb
settings.connection.emulator.step1: Start Android Studio Emulator or another compatible local emulator.
settings.connection.emulator.step2: Open MirroDeck or select the refresh button above the device list.
settings.connection.emulator.step3: Select a device with a name such as emulator-5554, then choose “Start mirroring”.
settings.connection.troubleshooting.unau: Unlock the phone and confirm the “Allow USB debugging” dialog.
settings.connection.troubleshooting.offl: Check the cable or network, then choose “Restart ADB” in the app notice.
settings.connection.troubleshooting.notF: Make sure the cable supports data transfer. On Windows, the phone manufacturer's ADB USB driver may also be required.
settings.connection.troubleshooting.notA: Pairing only grants authorization. In the connection step that opens automatically, enter the address from the main Wireless debugging screen.
settings.connection.security: Enable wireless debugging only on trusted local networks. Never expose its debugging port to the public internet, and turn it off when you are finished.
